label: Prison population rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research's World Prison Brief (2026 vintage, lastUpdated 2026-01-21), the national prison administrations' own counts compiled — prisoners per 100,000 population, pre-trial and remand detainees included, 225 areas, 1993-2026 — reached through OWID's chart door (the compilation's own site has no API and the UNODC collector portal is a client-rendered SPA with no discoverable machine door — the probe record). A compilation canonical by necessity: no collector prints the rate on any reachable wire. Witness tier = the WHO Health in Prisons database (GHO PRISON_A2, the European questionnaire collection's 2020 cross-section, 36 countries). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the boards' compilation beside the health-services collection, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research, World Prison Brief — ICPR's own reuse terms apply upstream); GHO witness = CC-BY-3.0-IGO.
notes: THE TODD ARCS PRINT THEMSELVES (todd_refs: 3 citations, 3 books). La Défaite de l'Occident's own six-country board rides the door directly: USA 683 (2000) -> 542 (2023) the never-matched American carceral mass (L'illusion économique read its growth 1980-1993 at 1.3-1.4 million inmates — the door's per-100k face of the same arc), RUSSIA 729 (2000) -> 300 (2023) the post-Soviet fall from the world's top (the emptied Gulag-aftermath the book sets against the American rise), FRANCE 82 -> 126 (2025) the slow French climb, GERMANY 85 -> 71, JAPAN 48 -> 33 the family-systems' own low, UK 121 -> 139. Qui est Charlie ?'s écroués arc (1980 vs 2014, +70% corrected for population) is the French segment of the same door — the seam that the book's own count is persons taken into custody (écroués, a flow) while the door prints the detention stock per 100k, two faces of the French penitentiary's expansion, displayed never reconciled. EL SALVADOR prints at the slice's top: 1659 in 2024, the estado de excepción's own arithmetic. THE HONEST LIMITS: L'illusion économique's US number is the TOTAL correctional population (probation and parole included — the book's own note, a face ~3x the incarcerated stock); the 1970s-back French écroués series and every pre-1993 face are BOOK data — territory curated, the same line the 19th-century boards hold; the UNODC collector tier is unreachable as a machine door (the SPA record); the witness carries 36 European countries at the single 2020 vintage (no trend on that tier, and no USA/Russia/Japan — the collection's own universe); the door's UK face is the United Kingdom aggregate (the chart's England-and-Wales sub-entity resolves to nothing and drops logged, the OWID door's own discipline).
